decks.notes: The deck focuses on accelerating mana generation through rituals and medallions to cast powerful spells like Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage. It aims to combo off by generating a large amount of mana to cast multiple spells in a single turn, often utilizing Wish to find the necessary pieces. The deck also includes cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Reckless Impulse to draw through the deck quickly while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Valakut Awakening and Artist's Talent provide additional utility and flexibility in the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Rider and Nourishing Shoal combo to cheat out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, while generating mana and additional creatures with cards like Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and Hooting Mandrills. The deck utilizes Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to tutor for key combo pieces, and includes control elements like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer to protect the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient combo strategy, while also having options for alternative win conditions through powerful creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and dealing damage efficiently to the opponent. By using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help protect your creatures from removal spells, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Scion of Draco provide additional value and flexibility to outmaneuver your opponent. This deck aims to quickly close out games with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and various support cards to generate a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble, Kozilek's Command, and Ancient Stirrings, along with key creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker, the deck aims to control the game while building towards its win condition through Blade of the Bloodchief and Emrakul, the Promised End. With the support of lands like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a deadly combination of creatures and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on assembling the Broodscale Bloodchief combo, using cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Glaring Fleshraker to generate counters on Basking Broodscale. It also includes control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent. Urza's Saga can help find key pieces of the combo, while Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls enable the early ramp and protection for the creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and use the combo finish to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Broodscale Bloodchief combo to generate large amounts of mana and deal massive amounts of damage to opponents. The deck utilizes various cards such as Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to create a powerful synergy that can overwhelm opponents quickly. It also includes cards like Kozilek's Command and Walking Ballista to control the board and deal with threats. The deck aims to establish a dominant position early on and finish off opponents with its powerful combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of disruption and card advantage, utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst, counterspells like Force of Negation and Spell Snare, and hand disruption like Thoughtseize. It also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Night's Whisper and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, while maintaining board control with creatures like Cecil, Dark Knight and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly grinding out value and winning the game through incremental advantages.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive strategies with the ability to repeatedly blink creatures for value. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can generate additional ETB triggers and protect key creatures. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and value generation, utilizing a mix of creatures with powerful abilities to outmaneuver the opponent and come out ahead in the 1 vs 1 matchup.

This deck focuses on quickly playing powerful Eldrazi creatures and leveraging cards like Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls to disrupt opponents' strategies. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements, it aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats while also controlling the board with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Ugin's Labyrinth. The deck's mana base is designed to support the Eldrazi creatures with lands like Eldrazi Temple and Unclaimed Territory, allowing for consistent creature deployment and pressure on opponents.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively use low-cost creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent while maximizing card draw and manipulation through spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration. By combining creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler with cheap spells like Lava Dart and Mutagenic Growth, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and finish them off with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The mana base is optimized for quick and efficient casting of spells, ensuring a fast and aggressive playstyle.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies, utilizing a mix of creature damage and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Key cards like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide early pressure, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge offer additional reach. The deck also includes disruption spells like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to control the board, and cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional power boosts. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly with a mix of efficient threats and removal.

This deck aims to flood the board with cheap artifacts and take advantage of affinity mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures. It utilizes cards like Mox Opal and Springleaf Drum to generate mana efficiently, while also including cards like Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts like Cranial Plating. The deck also includes some removal in the form of Galvanic Blast and Shadow spear to deal with opposing threats, while Thoughtcast helps provide card advantage to keep the pressure on and maintain tempo.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm and disrupt the opponent with a balanced mix of aggressive creatures and powerful burn spells. Using cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to pump up creatures, while controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and keep them on the back foot with a relentless assault of creature damage and direct burn spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game swiftly. The deck also includes additional support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment to help maintain board presence and deal additional damage. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive in order to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggression and synergy between different color themes, utilizing Leyline cards to boost the effectiveness of multicolored creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco. Consign to Memory and Leyline Binding provide removal options, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu pressure the opponent early on. Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial offer additional control and protection. The mana base consists of a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to different colors. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a diverse array of creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and cheap spells to quickly overwhelm opponents with its aggressive playstyle. By using cards like Mox Opal, Thoughtcast, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, the deck can generate a lot of mana and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent. Urza's Saga and Portable Hole provide additional utility and removal options. The goal is to deploy threats quickly, disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient spells, and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.
